= sqlparser changes for RTDB

This is sqlparser 0.63.0 from crates.io, under the Apache License 2.0 in LICENSE.TXT.
The published archive has SHA-256 `3679862809bd1f92e563cf6fd820e28f39135303668001c10331d5027183e8b4`.

RTDB's dialect enables the FROM-first query specification from the XTDB grammar.
The parser records each WHERE and SELECT tail in source order, including GROUP BY and HAVING before the SELECT they belong to.
The syntax tree retains the usual expression nodes and their spans, and the existing set-operation parser consumes each FROM-first specification as one operand.
The flag defaults to false, preserving the upstream dialects' FROM-first syntax.
